scope: Kernel-facing hardware resources from archived working-source and consumed ACK device trees; no new device acquisition
format: Properties are exact raw big-endian hex bytes; interpret reg/interrupt/clock cells using parent/provider bindings. Direct scalar supply/IRQ-parent/pinctrl links are resolved; multi-cell clock/DMA/IRQ references remain encoded, not guessed.
excluded: chosen bootargs/nonce/seed, idme identity, aliases and all properties outside explicit hardware allowlist
